name: x402-research-mcp
description: Pay-per-call x402 crypto research and Base address/approval risk checks. Testnet and preview by default; your own capped wallet pays.
long_description: MCP server for the x402-research API: crypto trend signals and briefs, Base address risk snapshots, ERC-20 approval enumeration, and x402 invoice/settlement checks. Preview mode (no key) returns the 402 terms and never signs. With a key, payments come from your dedicated low-balance wallet, capped per call (default 0.10 USDC) and per session (default 0.50 USDC), with a hardcoded payTo allowlist.

tools.name: signal
tools.description: Compact live trend signal for one asset (0.003 USDC).

tools.name: signal_batch
tools.description: Live trend signals for up to 10 assets (0.02 USDC flat).

tools.name: brief
tools.description: Technical + sentiment research brief for one asset (0.03 USDC).

tools.name: risk_snapshot
tools.description: Public-data red-flag snapshot of a Base address (0.03 USDC).

tools.name: invoice_decode
tools.description: Decode and sanity-check an x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; never signs.

tools.name: settlement_status
tools.description: Check an x402 settlement tx on Base.

tools.name: approval_enumerate
tools.description: List live ERC-20 approvals for a Base address (0.03 USDC).

tools.name: preflight
tools.description: One-call pre-sign check of a Base address (risk, approvals, OFAC, optional invoice) with a verdict (0.05 USDC).

network.title: Network
network.description: eip155:84532 (Base Sepolia, default) or eip155:8453 (Base mainnet)

preview.title: Preview mode
preview.description: "1" = never sign, only show 402 terms. Clear it to allow payments.

buyer_private_key.title: Buyer wallet private key (optional)
buyer_private_key.description: Dedicated LOW-BALANCE hot wallet only, never your main wallet. Leave empty for preview.

max_price_usdc.title: Max price per call (USDC)
max_price_usdc.description: Refuse any single call priced above this (default 0.10). Empty or 0 refuses all paid calls.

session_cap_usdc.title: Session spend cap (USDC)
session_cap_usdc.description: Total spend cap per server process (default 0.50).
